description: Enhanced pure enrichment module for temporal_stability signal. Must expose compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict] conforming to signal invariant. Must use age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, last_commit_days, release_frequency. Target: produce >=10 distinct scores across 34 synthetic fingerprints instead of current 3. Penalize recent repos (<30 days) and low-download-count outliers more aggressively. No DB writes, no network.
